title: Queue
emptySr: Viewers add songs by typing !sr in chat.
emptyRedeem: Viewers add songs by redeeming your channel-points reward.
emptyBoth: Viewers add songs with !sr in chat or by redeeming your channel-points reward.
emptyOff: Both request paths are off. Turn one on so viewers can add songs.
skipFailed: Could not skip the track. Try again in a moment.
skipNoDevice: No active Spotify device. Start playing something first.
skipReauth: Spotify no longer accepts this connection. Reconnect it and try again.
